name: Truth
overview: Scripture reveals that truth is an essential attribute of God, who is described as merciful, gracious, and abundant in truth, without iniquity or falsehood. Unlike man, God does not lie or change His promises, affirming the absolute and unchanging nature of divine truth. Those who fear God are called to be men of truth, embodying integrity and justice as reflections of God's perfect works. The deception of the serpent in the Garden of Eden contrasts starkly with God's truth, underscoring the importance of discerning and upholding truth in worship, judgment, and daily living.
